title: Dependency hygiene and supply chain
problem: CVE results do not establish licence compatibility or package-source trust.
rationale: Product dependency changes require both vulnerability and licence results; neither substitutes for the other. Reuse an existing approved licence checker; if none exists, show Unsupported until configured, never claim npm audit checks licences. No forced audit fix, automatic package upgrades or execution of newly introduced install scripts before approval.
applicability: Dependency, lockfile, install-script, source or licence-policy changes.
baseline_policy: No legacy waiver for required verification or release prerequisites.

target_check.deterministic: approved lockfiles in sync; frozen/locked install; unexpected source/script/lock changes flagged; project licence-policy/SBOM command checks direct and transitive SPDX identifiers against the approved allow/deny policy. Unknown, absent or ambiguous licence metadata is Review required, not an allowed licence.
target_check.reviewer: necessity, maintainer/source trust, install scripts, dual-licence choice and licence compatibility.
